shape_hint: A T-slot nut: a flat block with a T-shaped cross-section. The wide head (width e, thickness k) sits inside the T-slot under the table; a narrower neck of width a (equal to the slot opening) rises through the slot opening, giving total height h. A tapped through-hole of thread d runs vertically through the middle.

role_map.e: width of the head part (nominal max)

notes: DIN 508 T-slot nut (nut with a rectangular T-head for machine-tool T-slots). Row = the standard's preferred thread for each T-slot width a (DIN 650). Several slot widths also allow a smaller alternative thread (boltingspecialist lists e.g. slot 12 with M8, slot 10 with M6); the nut dimensions e, h, k depend on the slot width only, so the same nut serves both. ISO 299 is the same table (torqbolt.com page copies fasteners.eu). e and k are the nominal (maximum) sizes; the minimum limits are e - 0.5 (e - 1 for slots >= 28) and k - 0.3 / k - 0.5 (k - 1 for slots >= 28) according to fasteners.eu, Fuller and boltingspecialist, but are not tabulated here because the tolerance columns are only in two independent sources. Slots 16, 20, 24 and 42-54 are in the standard but have <3 sources. KS B 1039 (Korean T-slot nut) was not checked.
